proposedFirstCloudPhase.description: Rules cutover and read-only/denial verification while server/UI writers and connectivity remain off; not the 13-request trusted write window
proposedFirstCloudPhase.beforeCutover: Revalidate Render ownership/source/Free and writer=0/connectivity=0; one guarded CLI baseline checkpoint 0 must match Rules hash, gate 17, profiles, protected versions and absence of prospective targets
proposedFirstCloudPhase.rulesAction: Deploy only the exact candidate Firestore Rules to the staging default database; no indexes/Auth/IAM/profile changes
proposedFirstCloudPhase.afterCutover: Guarded candidate checkpoint 0, fresh local proof, Staff/Superadmin reader verification, one Superadmin SDK batch expected to deny, candidate checkpoint 0 again

sdkVerification.readerScope: Own profile, active staff/admin/superadmin directory <=200, active classroom schedules <=200, active DL in June 2027 <=200 using the existing monthly reader/cache contract
sdkVerification.expectedOutcome: permission-denied with zero committed documents, unchanged gate 17 and unchanged prospective receipts/targets
sdkVerification.possibleUnexpectedCommit: One fixed manual schedule on 2027-06-07 room 401 09:00-10:00, its fixed receipt and gate increment +1; stop immediately and preserve all evidence if this occurs
sdkVerification.durableReservation: IndexedDB add-only record before any test RPC, fixed review hash and action key, exact localhost:4311 origin; blocked storage and consumed slots fail closed

localFileUse.contains: Frozen staging directory UIDs and synthetic QA inputs; fresh audit hashes and explicit action approvals; no password, private key or token
localFileUse.behavior: Read in browser memory, not upload whole files to an application server; only the approved SDK batch fields can be sent to Firebase staging when explicitly authorized

stopAndFallback: Stop on source/hash/profile/gate drift, a reader failure, expired proof, consumed reservation or ambiguous SDK result; never clear local storage or re-arm a probe to make QA pass
Unexpected SDK success is a defect, even if it matches the future manual fixture; do not proceed to trusted API writes or delete the evidence
Keep server/UI writers and connectivity off; retain deny-client-write candidate Rules if already deployed; never restore legacy SDK writes as rollback
No billing enablement, card, upgrade, new key, IAM/profile change, physical deletion, production access or application push/deploy is authorized by this proposal
